content_data.email_purpose: To provide an urgent update on a critical security vulnerability discovered in our core platform and outline immediate mitigation steps.
key_points: Initial assessment indicates potential for unauthorized data access and transaction manipulation if exploited.
Our incident response team has activated and is actively working on containment and remediation.
A temporary patch is being prepared for immediate deployment, targeting deployment within the next few hours.
content_data.call_to_action: Review the attached preliminary incident report immediately and be prepared for an emergency cross-functional sync call within the next hour to finalize the deployment plan and communication strategy.
